environment: iPhone 18 Pro / iOS 27 simulator, synthetic stored audio
finding: AVAudioPlayer.prepareToPlay ran on the main thread and activated the audio session internally after the explicitly asynchronous activation had returned.
sourceOfTiming: Temporary diagnostic markers in an isolated source copy; no customer audio or data
prototypeResult: Six playback/background/access tests passed without the prior warning; final queue ordering and cancellation regression are verified separately.
fix: Prepare within the existing serial audio-session queue, enqueue before suspension, transfer the fresh player once to its UI owner, and recheck request generation before playing.

tests: backgrounding during preparation cancels playback and permits retry
